skills.name: Reward Function Contract Definition
skills.description: Check whether a submitted task was successfully cancelled or has finished running without blocking. Returns True only if the task is no longer pending.
skills.skill_body:
Call the done() method on a Future object to determine if the task has completed or been cancelled. This is a non-blocking check that returns immediately.

## Objective

Determine the terminal state of a future without blocking or retrieving its result
## Applicable Signals

- Future object is available from executor submission
- Caller requires immediate state feedback without waiting

## Contraindications

- Caller needs the actual result or exception from the task
- Future has not been submitted to an executor
- Caller requires blocking until completion

## Workflow Steps

- Obtain the Future object from executor submission
- Call done() on the Future object
- Receive boolean response indicating terminal state

## Constraints

- Must be called on a valid Future object
- Returns immediately without waiting for task completion

## Cautions

- This method does not retrieve the result or exception; use result() or exception() for that
- A False return does not guarantee the task will complete successfully

## Output Contract

- Boolean value: True if the future was cancelled or finished running, False if still pending
